qa_form.behavior: Confirm identity before discussing account details
qa_form.requirement: Before any account, plan, claim, or benefit detail is acknowledged or shared, the agent completes every step of the caller-verification procedure. Scored No if any account detail is discussed first or a step is skipped.

qa_form.behavior: Read the required call recording disclosure
qa_form.requirement: The agent reads the call recording disclosure at the start of the call, before the reason for the call is discussed.

qa_form.behavior: Document the resolution and next steps accurately
qa_form.requirement: Case notes state what was resolved, the next action, who owns it, and any date promised to the member.

qa_form.behavior: Follow the escalation procedure for unresolved issues
qa_form.requirement: An issue that cannot be resolved on the call is escalated through the documented escalation path before the case is closed.
Before ending the call the agent summarizes the next steps and confirms the member understands them.
The agent lets the member finish, reflects the concern back, and responds to what was actually asked.
